summary: This Form 8-K reports only routine transactional steps following Quantum Leap Acquisition Corp's May 2026 IPO: the underwriters fully exercised their over-allotment option to purchase 2,082,608 additional units at $10.00/unit, closing June 22, 2026, and on June 23 the ordinary shares and warrants began separate trading on the NYSE. No special-situation event is present—this is a standard capital raise/separation filing, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change.
